title: The Greatest Estate Developer
altTitles: Công Trình Sư Vĩ Đại Nhất
description: When civil engineering student Kim Suho falls asleep while reading a fantasy novel, he wakes up inside the story as Lloyd Frontera, a lazy and indebted nobleman whose family is on the verge of ruin. Determined to avoid Lloyd's miserable fate, Suho uses his modern engineering knowledge to transform the Frontera estate, develop infrastructure, solve financial problems, and build a better future. However, his unconventional methods and increasingly ridiculous schemes attract far more attention than he ever expected.
author: BK_Moon / Lee Hyun Min
